maria: pushed converted safetensors to s3://redwood-models/onboard/aurora-13b/v1/weights/*.safetensors — please sanity-check. Noticed tokenizer producing unk tokens for leading space in some prompts. Config.json shows 'dtype': 'fp16' but checkpoints were converted to bf16? Also TP shards zipped as tp-2? Need someone to verify shard layout and that KV cache axes align. cc @sam_w @aj :eyes:

sam_w: grabbing the artifacts now. quick checks I'll run: sha256, shape check via safetensors header, and compare config.hidden_size with model state dict. can you paste the s3 path for the manifest?

maria: path: s3://redwood-models/onboard/aurora-13b/v1/manifest.json
manifest has shard files aurora-13b-00001-of-00004.safetensors ...

aj: thanks. common issues: TP layout sometimes saved as [tp, head, ...] vs [head, tp, ...]. run this to assert per-tensor first dim % tp == 0: 
```
from safetensors import safe_open
with safe_open('aurora-13b-00001-of-00004.safetensors','rb') as f:
    for k,m in f.items():
        print(k, m.metadata['dtype'], m.shape)
```

leo.k: also validate tokenizer model: the SentencePiece model included? If not, we fallback to byte-level which causes unk for leading space. Try: `spm_model = SentencePieceProcessor(model_file='tokenizer.model')` and run `spm.encode(' Hello', out_type=str)` to see behavior. If piece IDs shift, we need to remap.

rachel: heads-up: CI job `packaging-verify` is queued. It runs `scripts/validate_packaging.sh` which checks dtype consistency, shard counts, and runs a small generation smoke test (seq_len=64). If that passes we can stage to dedicated. 

ops-bot: packaging-verify (aurora-13b/v1) queued on runner-3 — ETA ~4m

sam_w: ran header check — metadata shows dtype=bf16 in safetensors headers but config.json has "dtype": "fp16". That's inconsistent. Maria: did you set --target-dtype?

maria: I used conversion script with --target=bfloat16 because we wanted bf16 for downstream ops. I forgot to update config.json. I'll update and reupload manifest. Will also re-run conversion to ensure quantized kernels unaffected.

aj: if you're switching dtypes, check the embedding table shapes — some tooling expects float16 contiguous. Also run `torch.load(..., map_location='cpu')` to sanity-check numeric ranges on a small slice.

leo.k: small note about shard ordering: our loader expects shards in lexical order (00001...00004). If you renamed to start at 0 it will break. Confirm manifest order.

maria: manifest ordering good. I'll push config fix and ping when done. thanks all :heart:

rachel: after config fix, please trigger `packaging-verify` again. If CI passes, we do a canary on dedicated pool-qa (low qps) before promoting. :thumbsup:

sam_w: can help with the canary plan — I'll prepare traffic-shaping policy and monitor latency 95/99.

maria: uploaded updated config.json, bumped dtype->bf16 and added tokenizer.model to s3 path. re-running conversion smoke locally. ping when you see CI run. :rocket:

ops-bot: packaging-verify started for aurora-13b/v1 on runner-3

sam_w: one more check — ensure safetensors metadata includes 'redwood_shard_index' and 'tp_mesh' keys; otherwise the runtime won't reconstruct partitioning automatically.

maria: adding those metadata fields now and re-uploading shards. thanks.
